Name: Shop Stocks Expanded
Author: maiduong
Description:
Shop Stocks Expanded (1.6)
A lightweight shop expansion mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 that expands shop inventories across Pelican Town with useful resources, crops, fish, crafting materials, rare items, and more.
Designed to reduce grinding while still keeping progression and balance intact.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][heading]Features[/heading]
[color=#f1c232]Pierre[/color]
Sells seasonal crops, forage, flowers, seeds, produce, Tea Leaves, Strawberry Seeds, Starfruit, Sweet Gem Berry, Powdermelon, and many more seasonal farming items.

[color=#f1c232]Robin[/color]
Now sells Hardwood and Clay.

[color=#f1c232]Clint[/color]
Now sells Iridium Ore, Radioactive Ore, Copper/Iron/Gold/Iridium/Radioactive Bars, and Refined Quartz.

[color=#f1c232]Marnie[/color]
Sells animal products including Large Eggs, Duck Eggs, Wool, Truffle, Large Milk, and more.

[color=#f1c232]Willy[/color]
Sells various fish and crab pot items including Lobster, Crab, Shrimp, Snail, Tuna, Salmon, Eel, Squid, Void Salmon, and more.

[color=#f1c232]Marlon[/color]
Sells monster-related materials including Bug Meat and Dragon Tooth.

[color=#f1c232]Dwarf[/color]
Sells Cinder Shards.

[color=#f1c232]Traveling Cart[/color]
Can occasionally sell rare items such as Prismatic Shard, Dinosaur Egg, Pearl, Golden Egg, Golden Animal Cracker, Mystic Syrup, Treasure Chest, and more.

[color=#f1c232]JojaMart[/color]
Expanded inventory with fruits, mushrooms, forage, Coffee Beans, Joja crops, and seasonal items.

[heading][color=#6aa84f]Stock System[/color][/heading]
Most shop items now use limited stock quantities instead of infinite purchases to help preserve game balance and progression.
Willy's shop intentionally keeps lower stock limits compared to other vendors.

[heading]Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]Compatible with every mod, even mods which change shop stocks.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your Mods folder[/*]
[/list][heading]Credits[/heading]
Inspired by various Stardew Valley shop expansion concepts from the modding community.
